def transform(grid):
    """Recolor each uniform full row/column to 2, changing only its line color."""
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    rows = [(i, g[i][0]) for i in range(h) if len(set(g[i])) == 1]
    cols = [(j, g[0][j]) for j in range(w) if len({g[i][j] for i in range(h)}) == 1]
    for i, color in rows:
        for j in range(w):
            if g[i][j] == color:
                g[i][j] = 2
    for j, color in cols:
        for i in range(h):
            if g[i][j] == color:
                g[i][j] = 2
    return g
PY
